messages.text: Where is my order? Order ····, email (email hidden)
Used the store-orders skill

Rob, your two Thor P2 replacements (order Shop····) went out from our Tennessee warehouse today. The carrier has them arriving by November 15. Tracking: (tracking link hidden)

Your Magic M. 40T on order Shop···· ships December 7. We'll email you tracking as soon as it leaves.

When you're ready, send the KBOX back with the prepaid UPS label you already have, with Shop···· written on the box.
I dont want Thor as a replacement
Handed to the team · Replacement declined after it was already labelled. Return of the Thors plus a d

I understand, Rob, and I'm sorry. Those two Thors were sent before you'd agreed to them, and that's on us. The warehouse had already labelled the box, so I can't stop it now. When it arrives, please leave it sealed.

I've told the team you don't want the Thors and that they need to settle what replaces your KBOX. Someone will pick up your ticket and get back to you with an answer.

What would you like instead? I'll add it to your ticket so they have it.
I want what I paid for. Ill look this up first

That makes sense, Rob. I've added that to your ticket: you want what you paid for, a working 22 TH/s KBOX.

One honest thing before you look. GekkoScience has paused operations, so we can't get another KBOX right now. That's why the team will need to settle this with you directly.

Take your time. If you find something you'd rather have, tell me here and I'll add it to your ticket. Until then, leave the Thor box sealed when it arrives.
how hbout my money back?
Used the store-orders skill

I hear you, Rob. Before I put that to the team, here's one option you can have without waiting on anyone. Once your KBOX reaches our warehouse, you'd get the full $824.49 you paid as store credit. You could use it on anything in the store, including the Magic M. you already have on order.

If you'd still rather have your money back on your card, just say so. I'll put that request to the team on your ticket, and someone will get back to you with an answer.

Either way, nothing goes out until the KBOX gets back to us, so please do send it back with the UPS label.
What is thor 2
Let me pull the live listing so I give you the real details.
Read the hammer miner thor p2 page
Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner Thor P2

The Thor P2 is Hammer's small home Bitcoin miner. It's quiet, about 40 dB, and runs on WiFi or ethernet with its own power supply. Each one does about 10 TH/s at roughly 166 W in its Overclock Mode, or about 6.6 to 6.8 TH/s at 70 to 88 W in Normal Mode.

So the two we sent come to about 20 TH/s at around 330 W. Your KBOX was rated 22 TH/s at the same 330 W.

If they'd work for you, just keep them. If not, leave the box sealed. Your call either way.
so thats it huh/ Guess I better look up thore 2

No, Rob, that's not it. Nothing is settled until you decide. Your ticket is open with the team, and it already says you don't want the Thors.

You've got three choices. You can keep the two Thors. You can take the full $824.49 as store credit once the KBOX is back with us. Or you can ask for your money back, and I'll put that request to the team.

Here's the Thor P2 page if you want to read up: https://heliumdeploy.com/products/hammer-miner-thor-p2

Once you've decided, tell me here and I'll add it to your ticket.
show me one

Here's the Thor P2: https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0584/2419/7302/files/p2frontside.webp?v=1784740629

It's a compact desktop unit with a fan and heatsink on top and an external power brick, a lot smaller than your KBOX. The product page has more photos: https://heliumdeploy.com/products/hammer-miner-thor-p2
this is twice as much electical;. I Have 20 of these octaks all of theme are no good. I swore i would never buy one.     I dont like this trade. Give me another Magic M.? thats less then this kbox
Used the order-swap skill

I hear you, Rob. Two Thors pull the same power as the KBOX for less hashrate, so I get why you don't want them. And after 20 Octaxes that let you down, I understand swearing off small units.

A second Magic M. 40T is $799, which is less than the $824.49 you paid for the KBOX. It isn't on the shelf yet, though. It's a pre-order that ships by December 21, which is after the one you already have coming on December 7.

Is a December 21 Magic M. what you want instead of the Thors? Say yes and I'll put it on your ticket.
so that will be 2 Magic miner 40th?

Yes, Rob. You'd have two Magic M. 40Ts. One is the order you already have (Shop····), which ships December 7. The second would replace your KBOX and ships by December 21.

The two Thors would then come back to us instead of staying with you, so leave that box sealed when it arrives.

Do you want me to put that on your ticket?
what to tell them I want 2 magic miners
Handed to the team · The replacement already shipped as Thors, so swapping it for a MM needs a person

You don't need to tell them anything, Rob. I've put it on your ticket in your words. You want a Magic M. 40T instead of the two Thors, so you'd have two in total: the one on December 7 and a second by December 21.

The team needs to approve the change and arrange for the Thors to come back. Someone will pick up your ticket and get back to you by email. In the meantime, keep the Thor box sealed and send the KBOX back with your UPS label marked Shop····.
My return for KD box and the 2 thors

Here's where both stand, Rob.

KBOX: your prepaid UPS label is ready. ····
Write Shop···· on the box and drop it at any UPS location. You can send it now.

Two Thors: there's no return label for these yet. The box should arrive by November 15. Keep it sealed, and don't put it in with the KBOX. Sending the Thors back is on your ticket with your Magic M. request, and the team will send you the return details for them.
I never received them yet. I need the address to send these back to.

I know they haven't arrived yet, Rob. The carrier shows the Thors arriving by November 15.

You don't need to write an address on anything. The KBOX label already has our warehouse address printed on it, so just tape it on and drop the box at UPS.

For the Thors, I've asked on your ticket for a prepaid label like the KBOX one, with the address already on it. Please don't ship them back without that label. A box with no label and no reference can't be matched to you at the warehouse.
got it. Send them where?

Both go to our warehouse in Chattanooga, Tennessee:

ShipBob, Inc. [ATTN: Returns]
(address hidden)
Chattanooga, TN (postal code hidden)

The KBOX label already has this printed on it, so the KBOX can go out now. Hold the Thors until their prepaid label reaches you. Then the address will be on that label too, and you won't have to pay for shipping.
No RMA?

Yes, Rob. The KBOX has its RMA, Shop····. Write that clearly on the outside of the box, and that's how the warehouse matches it to you.

The Thors don't have an RMA yet. It'll come with their prepaid label once the team approves the swap to the Magic M.. Until then, keep that box sealed.
I put it back in the box it came from

That's perfect, Rob. Put the power supply in with it if it came with one. Tape the UPS label on a flat side, write Shop···· on the outside, and drop it at any UPS location. You can track it with (number hidden).

Once it reaches our warehouse in Chattanooga, it'll show up on your ticket.
ok thank you

You're welcome, Rob. I'm sorry this has dragged on so long.

To recap: the KBOX goes back now with its label and Shop···· on the box. Leave the Thor box sealed when it arrives. Your request to swap the Thors for a second Magic M. is on your ticket, and the team will email you their answer along with the Thors' return label.
